headline.zh: OpenAI 正式發表 GPT-6 Astra：主打深度推論、原生 Computer Use 與工作流自動化
headline.en: OpenAI Unveils GPT-6 Astra with Advanced Reasoning and Native Computer Use

detail.zh: OpenAI 推出新一代旗艦模型 GPT-6 Astra，聚焦企業與專業工作流程，顯著強化原生操作電腦（Computer Use）、視覺設計審美與長鏈推論能力。對於需要打造自主 Agent 與多步驟複雜任務的開發者而言，新模型在指令遵循與環境互動上的延遲與可靠度均有大幅躍升。
detail.en: OpenAI announced GPT-6 Astra, tailored for professional workflows with native computer use, sharper design judgment, and advanced multi-step reasoning. For developers building autonomous agents, the model promises major improvements in execution reliability and environment interaction.

headline.zh: OpenAI 宣稱解出納維-斯托克斯千禧難題，陶哲軒示警：公開數學問題正面臨不可逆的 AI 淘金枯竭
headline.en: OpenAI Claims Navier-Stokes Solution as Terence Tao Warns of AI 'Mining' Open Problems

detail.zh: OpenAI 運用內部未公開模型給出百萬美元千禧難題「Navier-Stokes 平滑性」的解答，引發學術圈掠奪爭議。數學家陶哲軒警告，AI 正在非永續地「開採」公開數學題庫，甚至只要傳出某學者正著手某難題，AI 就會迅速平推解決，這將迫使研究者不再公開分享早期成果。
detail.en: OpenAI's claim of resolving the Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness problem via an unreleased model has sparked academic controversy. Mathematician Terence Tao warned that AI is 'non-renewably mining' good open problems, potentially disincentivizing researchers from sharing active work.

headline.zh: DeepSeek 發表 v4.1 Flash：性價比反超 v4 Pro，小模型推論速度與成本再破底
headline.en: DeepSeek Launches v4.1 Flash: Faster and Cheaper than v4 Pro with Higher Capability

detail.zh: DeepSeek 突發上線 v4.1 Flash，在多項基準測試中展現超越既有 v4 Pro 的推論水平，且推論 token 定價與延遲均創下新低。社群實測顯示其在長文本理解與程式碼生成的每秒 token 吞吐量顯著提升，進一步壓縮了高階商業 API 的溢價空間。
detail.en: DeepSeek introduced v4.1 Flash, delivering higher benchmark capability than its predecessor v4 Pro at a fraction of the token cost. Early developer benchmarks highlight impressive throughput in code generation and long-context processing, putting further pricing pressure on proprietary frontier models.

headline.zh: IBM 開源 SOTA 時序基礎模型 Granite PatchTST-FM-r2，採商用友善授權
headline.en: IBM Releases SOTA Granite PatchTST-FM-r2 Time Series Model Under Commercial License

detail.zh: IBM Research 在 Hugging Face 發布新一代時序預測基礎模型 PatchTST-FM-r2，在零樣本與微調時序基準測試上取得 SOTA 成績。模型提供完整的預訓練權重與推論管線，並採用商用友善的開源授權，適合工業異常偵測與金融預測應用。
detail.en: IBM Research open-sourced PatchTST-FM-r2, a state-of-the-art time series foundation model available on Hugging Face with a commercially permissive license. The release offers robust zero-shot forecasting performance, making it highly attractive for industrial monitoring and financial applications.

headline.zh: 社群驗證開源 Qwen 3.8 可完美接軌 GPT-5.5 Pro 推論 Prefill 思維鏈
headline.en: Qwen 3.8 Proven to Follow GPT-5.5 Pro Reasoning Prefills Seamlessly

detail.zh: 開發者發布 Gist 概念驗證，展示僅需在 prompt 注入 GPT-5.5 Pro 的思維鏈前綴（reasoning prefill），開源輕量級模型 Qwen 3.8 即可完全順著其推論路徑輸出高階解答。這為本機推論結合雲端引導的混合蒸餾架構提供了低成本實作途徑。
detail.en: A popular developer gist demonstrates that local Qwen 3.8 models can reliably continue reasoning chains prefilled by GPT-5.5 Pro. This provides a practical, low-cost paradigm for hybrid distillation and complex problem-solving using local weights guided by frontier outputs.

headline.zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Images 2.5 API，新增 Sunburst 與 Flare 雙端點
headline.en: OpenAI Releases ChatGPT Images 2.5 API with Sunburst and Flare Endpoints

detail.zh: OpenAI 更新影像生成模型至 2.5 版，在 API 中正式提供 gpt-image-2.5-sunburst 與 flare 兩個端點。新模型大幅改善了多輪對話中的局部修圖與主體一致性保留能力，延遲顯著降低，實測 Sunburst 在細節遵從度上表現最為優異。
detail.en: OpenAI upgraded its image generation suite to ChatGPT Images 2.5, exposing gpt-image-2.5-sunburst and gpt-image-2.5-flare in the API. The update enhances subject consistency across multi-turn edits and reduces latency, with Sunburst delivering notably superior prompt fidelity.

headline.zh: Opus Five 示範即時前端視覺指令修改：「Claude，把按鈕改成藍色」引發熱議
headline.en: Opus Five Demoes Direct Visual DOM Mutation via Claude Agent Commands

detail.zh: 開發工具 Opus Five 展示了直接透過自然語言命令驅動 Claude 進行前端網頁元件即時檢測、定位與樣式代碼修改的工作流。此專案在 Hacker News 獲得近千熱度，突顯了開發者對「免手動搜尋程式庫、直接語義化改 UI」的強烈需求。
detail.en: Developer tool Opus Five showed off seamless real-time UI inspection and direct DOM manipulation driven by Claude agent instructions. The demo garnered over 900 points on Hacker News, emphasizing strong demand for zero-friction natural language front-end editing.

headline.zh: Sebastian Raschka 深入解析 GPT-6 Astra：循環架構與隱藏推論狀態
headline.en: Sebastian Raschka Analyzes GPT-6 Astra: Looped Transformers and Hidden Reasoning

detail.zh: 知名 AI 研究者 Sebastian Raschka 針對 GPT-6 Astra 的技術特性發表分析，探討其採用循環 Transformer（Looped Transformers）進行隱式思維推論的機制。此架構使模型能在不顯式生成大量草稿 token 的前提下，於隱藏層迭代深化運算，大幅縮減上下文占用與推論開銷。
detail.en: AI researcher Sebastian Raschka explored the mechanics of GPT-6 Astra, highlighting its likely adoption of looped transformer architectures and latent reasoning states. This approach allows deeper multi-pass computation directly within hidden layers, cutting context window bloat and inference latency.

headline.zh: Google 發表全基因組單鹼基突變 AI 評估系統，突破非編碼區預測瓶頸
headline.en: Google's AI Evaluates Single-Base Mutations Across Entire Human Genome

detail.zh: Google 釋出最新基因組 AI 模型，成功對人類基因組中所有可能的單鹼基變異（SNV）進行致病性與功能性預測。該系統特別突破了過去難以解析的非編碼區域，為計算生物學與精準醫療領域的下游開發者提供了高解析度的預訓練特徵庫。
detail.en: Google unveiled an AI system that evaluates every single-nucleotide variant across the human genome, predicting functional and clinical significance. The model makes substantial headway in analyzing previously intractable non-coding regions, providing high-resolution representations for computational biology.

headline.zh: Anthropic 資深安全研究員辭職並發出警訊：自我演進 AI 恐失控帶來生存危機
headline.en: Anthropic Safety Researcher Resigns, Warning Self-Improving AI Poses Extinction Risk

detail.zh: Anthropic 安全研究員 Jacob Coxon 正式請辭，直指業界為求商業競爭忽視對「自我改進超智慧模型」的控制機制，並評估毀滅性風險超過 10%。此事件再度引發開發社群對前沿實驗室 Safety 承諾與競賽節奏（Pacing Agreements）的嚴肅檢視。
detail.en: Anthropic safety researcher Jacob Coxon resigned over fears that frontier labs are racing heedlessly toward uncontrollable self-improving models, putting the extinction risk above 10%. His departure reignites intense debate over commercial competitive pressures versus safety pacing agreements.

headline.zh: AI 對齊專家 Paul Christiano 加入 OpenAI 基金會董事會與安全委員會
headline.en: Alignment Pioneer Paul Christiano Joins OpenAI Foundation Board

detail.zh: RLHF 與 AI 對齊領域代表人物 Paul Christiano 正式加入 OpenAI 基金會董事會及其安全與防護委員會。在近期安全團隊動盪後，Christiano 的加入被外界視為 OpenAI 試圖重整對齊研究架構與技術標準制定的關鍵防線。
detail.en: Paul Christiano, a pioneer of RLHF and alignment research, has been appointed to the OpenAI Foundation Board and its Safety and Security Committee. His return to frontline governance signals an effort to reinforce alignment standards amidst ongoing industry scrutiny.

headline.zh: Suno 正式釋出 v6 音樂模型，全面改採唱片業授權資料重新訓練以規避侵權訴訟
headline.en: Suno launches v6 music model trained from scratch exclusively on licensed record label catalogs.

headline.zh: Apple 推出 Reference Image 技術，透過 iPhone 18 Pro 感光元件硬體簽章杜絕 AI 偽造
headline.en: Apple unveils Reference Image on iPhone 18 Pro to cryptographically sign sensor pixels against AI tampering.

headline.zh: Amazon Prime Video 推出即時 AI 對嘴技術，讓配音語音精準吻合演員唇形
headline.en: Amazon Prime Video rolls out AI-powered lip sync matching actor mouth movements to dubbed audio.

headline.zh: 前 OpenAI 員工創辦 Besxar，計劃利用 SpaceX 獵鷹九號將晶圓製造搬上太空真空軌道
headline.en: Former OpenAI staffer launches Besxar to build orbital semiconductor fabs utilizing space vacuum via SpaceX.
